title: flow_view Universal Trace
description: The Universal Trace. Single source of truth for the contract between execution adapters and visualization renderers. Generated artifacts live in ../generated and are never hand-edited. Normative prose: .kiro/specs/flow-view/trace-schema.md

Profile.description: Deployment profile that produced the trace.

RunStatus.description: How the run ended. Every status other than ok/error means the trace is truncated but still valid and replayable.

BranchKind.description: Syntactic construct that made a control-flow decision.

BranchOutcome.description: Which way control actually went. Derived from observed execution, never by re-evaluating the condition.

FrameKind.description: Nature of a call frame. 'library' marks an opaque call whose interior is deliberately not traced.

ObjKind.description: Renderer hint for a heap object. Describes representation, not semantics.

ObjSetOp.description: Kind of mutation. Distinguishes replacing element 3 from inserting at 3, which animate differently.

StdinSource.description: Whether input came from a human at run time or was supplied up front. Measured from how long the read blocked, not assumed.

MetricName.description: Counters surfaced in the metrics view.

Shape.description: Inferred data structure shape. Advisory; always user-overridable. 'unknown' renders as a generic object graph.

Confidence.description: How much to trust an inference.

NoteLevel.description: Severity of an adapter diagnostic shown to the user.

Value.description: A value held by a variable or heap slot. Never a nested object: aggregates are referenced by id so that aliasing and cycles are representable, and so mutating a shared object is one event rather than many. Exactly one variant key must be present.

oneOf.title: prim
oneOf.description: An immediate value. Integers outside IEEE-754 safe range are strings with bigint set. NaN and infinities are the strings 'nan', 'inf', '-inf'.

prim.description: null, bool, int, float, or string.

bigint.description: Set when prim is a string carrying an integer too large for a double.

truncated.description: Full original length, when a long string was shortened.

oneOf.title: ref
oneOf.description: A reference to a heap object.

oneOf.title: unavailable
oneOf.description: The runtime could not report this value. Deliberate: an honest gap beats a fabricated number.

Arg.description: One argument at a call site.

SourceFile.description: A source file participating in the run.

Limits.description: Resource bounds applied to the run. Present so the UI can explain a truncated trace.

Session.description: Trace header. Sent once, before any events.

guards_active.description: Sandbox guards actually in force on this platform. The UI reports these verbatim rather than implying protection that is not present.

StackEntry.description: One line of a rendered stack trace.

CollapseEffect.description: Net before/after state for one slot touched inside a folded span. This is what makes a collapse event invertible.

key.description: Variable name, or heap key rendered as a string.

FrameState.description: A frame as captured in a snapshot.

ObjectState.description: A heap object as captured in a snapshot.

slots.description: Key (index or field, rendered as a string) to value.

order.description: Explicit slot ordering where it is meaningful, as for lists and arrays.

LoopState.description: An active loop region as captured in a snapshot.

StateSnapshot.description: Program state at a point in the trace. Delta-encoded against base_seq unless full is set: a whole-heap snapshot every few hundred steps would outweigh the events it exists to accelerate.

full.description: True for a keyframe carrying complete state; false for a delta.

base_seq.description: Snapshot this delta applies to. Absent when full.

removed_frames.description: Frames gone since base_seq, for deltas.

removed_objects.description: Objects gone since base_seq, for deltas.

seq.description: Monotonic from 0. Identity of a point in time.

step.description: Step ordinal. Present on events the user can land on; absent on bookkeeping events.

path.description: Source file. Omitted when it is the entry file.

ms.description: Milliseconds since run start, for the timeline view.

Event_run_end.description: Always emitted, including on limit breach. A truncated trace is a valid trace.
